items.titleEn: Arteta sets Arsenal 100-point Premier League target to emulate Manchester City
items.summaryEn: ‘It’s only been done once and that’s what we want’Arteta not being drawn on City’s financial chargesMikel Arteta has set Arsenal the ­target of emulating Manchester City by becoming only the second team in Premier League history to record 100 points in a season.Arteta was an assistant for Pep Guardiola’s side when they achieved the landmark in the 2017-18 campaign, beating second-placed Manchester United by 19 points. bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has set Arsenal the ­target of emulating Manchester City by becoming only the second team in Premier League history to record 100 points in a season.

Arteta was an assistant for Pep Guardiola’s side when they achieved the landmark in the 2017-18 campaign, beating second-placed Manchester United by 19 points. City head to the Emirates Stadium on Sunday already trailing Arsenal by six points after just 11 games, with Enzo Maresca’s side having failed to win any of their four previous league matches.

Arsenal drew against Newcastle last week and have only dropped points in one other game so far: a 3-0 defeat at Brighton in September. But Arteta said that his team will have to be exceptional if they are to match City’s record of only two defeats and four draws across the whole season.

“We haven’t hit the level yet that they did and I was there when we did 100 points,” he said. “That’s the level that is unprecedented and every record was beaten. That’s what we have to aim for because that’s what I expect that all the clubs and all the squads with the capacity they have in this league are going to aim for this season or the next few seasons.”

Asked if that City side was his benchmark as a manager, Arteta added: “You want to be the best version that you can. That’s something that’s been done only once in the league and that’s what we want to do. It’s going to be extremely difficult but we want to be as close as that because that’s what is going to increase the probability of winning the Championship again.”

City finished their record-breaking season in 2017-18 with a +79 goal difference and wrapped up the title with five games to spare. It also falls inside the nine-season period when they have been found guilty of more than 100 breaches of the Premier League’s financial regulations. City have yet to learn their fate but Arteta denied that the uncertainty over what punishment they will receive could overshadow the game on Sunday.

“I hope that it doesn’t because this is a process that is still open and not resolved and I wouldn’t know what is going to happen,” he said. “I think when we have two teams at the level that they’re both in right now with the quality of play that they have on that pitch it’s a massive game and a big game to enjoy.”
Arteta also said retaining Arsenal’s title on the pitch is “the only thing that we should put the energy and the focus on”.

Arsenal supporters are being urged to arrive early on Sunday for a pre-match display. But Arteta bizarrely refused to comment on whether emotions will be running high among fans when City come to north London for the first time since being found guilty. “I don’t know. That’s something very individual and I don’t want to go there,” he said.

David Raya could play against City despite fears that the Spain goalkeeper could be out for a substantial period after injuring a shoulder against Newcastle last week. Kepa Arrizabalaga deputised against Borussia Dortmund in midweek and Arteta said he has full faith in the former Chelsea goalkeeper despite his error in the Carabao Cup final against City this year.

“The experience that Kepa has is already incredible. In the teams that he’s been involved [in], the squads that he’s been involved [in], the trophies that he’s won. There’s none of that [doubts],” he said.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔为阿森纳设定英超百分目标，希望复制曼城壮举
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔设定阿森纳单赛季100分目标，力争复制曼城纪录。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔为阿森纳设定了目标，希望效仿曼城，成为英超历史第二支在单赛季拿到100积分的球队。
在2017-18赛季曼城达成这一里程碑时，阿尔特塔是瓜迪奥拉手下的助教，当时他们以领先第二名曼联19分的优势夺冠。经过11轮比赛后，曼城将于周日做客酋长球场，目前落后阿森纳6分，马雷斯卡的球队在过去的四场联赛中一场未胜。
阿森纳上周战平了纽卡斯尔，本赛季迄今为止仅在另一场比赛中丢过分：即9月份客场0比3不敌布莱顿。但阿尔特塔表示，要想追平曼城全季仅输两场、平四场的纪录，球队必须表现得无比出色。
“我们还没有达到他们当年的水平，而当时拿到100分时我就在现场，”他说，“那是史无前例的水平，所有纪录都被打破了。这是我们必须争取的，因为我期望这个联赛中所有具备这种能力的俱乐部和阵容，在本赛季或未来几个赛季都会以此为目标。”
当被问及那支曼城是否是他作为主帅的标杆时，阿尔特塔补充道：“你想成为你能做到的最好的版本。这在联赛中只发生过一次，而这正是我们想要做到的。这将极其艰难，但我们希望尽可能接近这个目标，因为这会提高再次赢得冠军的概率。”
曼城在2017-18赛季打破纪录时净胜球达到+79，并在还剩五场比赛时提前夺冠。这也发生在他们被裁定违反英超财务规则超过100次的九个赛季周期之内。曼城尚未得知最终裁决，但阿尔特塔否认关于他们将受到何种处罚的不确定性会掩盖周日的比赛。
“我希望不会，因为这是一个仍在进行且尚未解决的程序，我也不知道会发生什么，”他说，“我认为当我们拥有两支目前处于这种水平、球场上展现出如此高水准的球队时，这是一场意义重大、值得好好享受的比赛。”
阿尔特塔还表示，在球场上卫冕阿森纳的冠军是“我们唯一应该倾注精力和专注的事情”。
阿森纳球迷被呼吁在周日提前入场，观看赛前展示。但对于曼城自被定罪以来首次来到北伦敦时球迷的情绪是否会分外高涨，阿尔特塔却出人意料地拒绝置评。“我不知道。这是非常个人的事情，我不想涉足，”他说。
尽管人们担心西班牙门将大卫·拉亚在上周对阵纽卡斯尔时肩部受伤可能会缺阵较长时间，但他仍有可能在对阵曼城的比赛中出场。凯帕·阿里萨瓦拉加在周中的欧冠中顶替了首发，阿尔特塔表示，尽管凯帕在今年联赛杯决赛对阵曼城时出现失误，但他对这位前切尔西门将充满信心。
“凯帕拥有的经验简直令人难以置信。在他效力过的球队、身处过的阵容以及赢得过的奖杯中（都有体现）。这些（质疑）都不存在，”他说。

items.titleEn: Wycombe clash in EFL Trophy confirmed
items.summaryEn: We'll face The Chairboys at Adams Park in our first knockout tie of the season
bodyEn: Our EFL Trophy tie against Wycombe Wanderers has been confirmed for Tuesday, December 22 at Adam's Park, with kick-off scheduled for 7pm in High Wycombe.

Having lost our opening group match to Barnet, David Horseman's under-21s struck late to beat Leyton Orient and AFC Wimbledon, booking a place in the Round of 32 for the first time in the group stage format.

The next step on the road to Wembley takes us to Adam's Park to take on The Chairboys, who beat Chelsea under-21s and Bristol Rovers before losing on penalties to Reading, to win their group and secure a home tie.
Ticket information will be confirmed in due course, and the tie will also be broadcast live on Sky Sports.

items.titleZh: 确认在英格兰联赛锦标赛中对阵威科姆
items.summaryZh: 我们将在本赛季首场淘汰赛中做客亚当斯公园球场对阵威科姆。
bodyZh: 我们对阵威科姆流浪者的英格兰联赛锦标赛已确定于12月22日星期二在亚当斯公园球场举行，开球时间定于海威科姆当地时间晚上7点。
在小组赛首战输给巴尼特后，大卫·霍斯曼率领的U21梯队凭借后程发力先后击败莱顿东方和温布尔登，队史首次在小组赛阶段晋级32强。
通往温布利之路的下一站将带我们前往亚当斯公园球场挑战威科姆。他们此前击败了切尔西U21和布里斯托尔流浪者，随后在点球大战中不敌雷丁，但仍夺得小组头名并获得主场作战资格。
门票信息将适时公布，本场比赛也将通过天空体育进行现场直播。

items.titleEn: Renée Slegers departs as Arsenal Women head coach
items.summaryEn: Renée departs following a disappointing start to the 2026/27 season, with assistant coach Aaron D’Antino also leaving the club.
bodyEn: We can confirm Renée Slegers has left her position as head coach of our women’s first team by mutual consent.
Renée departs following a disappointing start to the 2026/27 season, with assistant coach Aaron D’Antino also leaving the club.
The process of appointing a successor is underway and we will update in due course. Assistant coach Melissa Clarke-Reed will take charge of the team in the interim period.

Renée took charge as interim head coach in October 2024, before stepping into the permanent role in January 2025. She led us to our historic second UEFA Women’s Champions League title in May 2025, while we won the inaugural FIFA Women’s Champions Cup in February 2026.
Aaron joined our coaching staff in August 2018 and has been a highly respected and valued member of the club for several years, playing a key role in successive backroom teams.
“It was an extremely difficult decision to part ways with Renée, who has led the team with dedication and commitment throughout her time here,” said Director of Women’s Football Clare Wheatley.

“In leading us to glory in the Champions League and the inaugural FIFA Champions Cup, Renée has made a significant and lasting contribution to the history of Arsenal Football Club, with close support from Aaron.
“After careful reflection, it is clear that results have been below the expected level, and change is necessary.”

Our CEO Richard Garlick added: “Renée is a wonderful person who has made a significant contribution to Arsenal, playing an integral role in some of the most historic achievements in the club’s history, including our Champions League and FIFA Champions Cup successes.
“Aaron also deserves special recognition for his service to Arsenal over many years, during which time he has helped us to win several titles.
“Our ambition is to compete for and win major trophies consistently, and our recent results have led us to conclude that a change is necessary to give us the best opportunity to achieve those goals.”
Everyone at Arsenal would like to thank Renée and Aaron for their contributions to the club and wish them every success in their future careers.

items.titleZh: 雷娜·斯勒格尔斯离任阿森纳女足主教练
items.summaryZh: 雷娜在2026/27赛季开局不佳后离任，助教阿伦·德安蒂诺也一同离开俱乐部。
bodyZh: 我们可以确认，经双方友好协商，雷娜·斯勒格尔斯已卸任阿森纳女足一线队主教练职务。
雷娜在2026/27赛季开局不佳后离任，助教阿伦·德安蒂诺也一同离开俱乐部。
新任主教练的选聘工作正在进行中，我们将适时公布最新消息。助理教练梅丽莎·克拉克-里德将在过渡期内带队。
雷娜于2024年10月担任临时主教练，随后于2025年1月正式转正。她在2025年5月带领我们夺得了队史第二座历史性的欧洲女子冠军联赛冠军，并在2026年2月赢得了首届国际足联女子冠军杯。
阿伦于2018年8月加入我们的教练组，多年来一直是俱乐部备受尊敬和珍视的成员，在历届教练团队中发挥了关键作用。
女足总监克莱尔·惠特利表示：“与雷娜分道扬镳是一个极其艰难的决定，她在任职期间一直全心全意地带领着球队。”
“在阿伦的密切支持下，雷娜带领我们在欧冠联赛和首届国际足联冠军杯中斩获荣耀，为阿森纳足球俱乐部的历史作出了重大且持久的贡献。”
“经过深思熟虑，很显然目前的战绩低于预期水平，改变是必要的。”
我们的首席执行官理查德·加利克补充道：“雷娜是一位杰出的人，她为阿森纳作出了重大贡献，在我们俱乐部历史上一些最具历史意义的成就中发挥了不可或缺的作用，其中包括我们赢得欧冠和国际足联冠军杯的辉煌时刻。”
“阿伦多年来对阿森纳的服务也值得特别认可，在此期间他帮助我们赢得了多项冠军。”
“我们的雄心是持续竞争并赢得重大奖杯，近期的战绩让我们得出结论：必须作出改变，以为实现这些目标提供最佳契机。”
阿森纳的全体同仁感谢雷娜和阿伦对俱乐部作出的贡献，并祝愿他们在未来的职业生涯中一切顺利。

items.titleEn: Every word of Arteta's pre-City press conference
items.summaryEn: Read what the boss had to say before we face Manchester City at Emirates Stadium
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta faced the media on Friday afternoon ahead of our Premier League clash with Manchester City at Emirates Stadium on Sunday.
The boss discussed David Raya and William Saliba's fitness, a potential title race with City and our performances since the international break.
Find out what the boss had to say below, or press play on the video at the top of the page to watch the press conference in full.
on Raya's availability:I don't know, we still have a few hours before the game so we're just trying to get everybody back.
on if he's training:Yes, they're all training. Bukayo is also training.
on if Raya is diving around:That I'm not sure.
on if there's a ray of hope that he might be involved:Yes.
on if the goalkeeper who starts will have a surname ending in A:Probably. Keep going!

on Raya's importance to us and doing our best to get him back:Yes, but that's what we do with every single player, we treat them in the same way. Every player has the same mindset; they want to be available, they want to be in the best possible condition, and there's no difference between them.

on if Kepa will have the Carabao Cup final in the back of his mind if he plays:The experience that Kepa has is already incredible. You just look at the teams that he's been involved in, the squad that he's been involved in, the trophies that he's won. So, there is none of that.

on City are struggling since the Premier League ruling:I don't know, that's a question for them. What I can see is when I watch them play, in a lot of the games they have won or they have done more than enough to merit the win than the opponent at least, but this is football - to win games. That's a merit to the way that they play and what Enzo is doing.

on if City's title challenge is over if we beat them:When we play home games against big teams, that becomes crucial in the title challenge. We know how important those home games are and to make the difference. But obviously, the second part, we're in November and we know how long we still have to play, but that's for every single team.

on if we still see City as our main title rivals:We don't know. I think the challenge is for us and the opportunity is for us. We cannot control what the opponents are going to do. We just need to give ourselves the best version. I'm sure the atmosphere is going to be incredible on Sunday and we need to enjoy and embrace those kinds of games and go for it.

on nearly reaching 700 goals under his management despite criticism of our attack:This is data and people have opinions or there will be moments about that, but I'm not concerned. I'm concerned about preparing the team to have the best possible mindset, energy, physical condition and clarity to beat City. That's it.
on only scoring four goals from our last 64 shots:Let's keep making more and you will see how many goals we score. I'm not concerned about that.

on if Maresca's personality is reflected by his team:I know Enzo personally, but not that much to describe him. I think everybody that has worked with him thinks he is a phenomenal guy, someone that loves and breathes football, who is very, very analytical. He was a great player and what he's done in his managerial career already so young, is very, very impressive. So I can only describe what I've seen and the little bits that I know of him, which is everything super positive.

on the positioning of our full-backs during attacks:In relation to what the opponent does, we need to move and we need to occupy spaces and relationships that, in our opinion, are going to hurt the opposition. The more unpredictable we are, the easier that’s going to be.

on the difference of trying to retain a title:There's more hunger to do it again, to have the same feeling, to have those moments again together. Everybody puts in such an unbelievable shift every single week to give us the chance to prepare for the games, to analyse the opponent, to create the right atmosphere around the boys and actually win the game. If you do it week in, week out, then you’re just building something that can give you the chance to go through those moments again, and we all want them again.

on if it matters how many goals we win by:I prefer to win by five, or six, or seven, for sure. I’m going to enjoy the game much more, especially the last few minutes. The boys are going to have more fun. I think scoring goals is ultimately what creates a good feeling, joy, happiness, celebration around the stands. It’s the most important thing in football, apart from winning.

on the respect our players and City's have for each other:You admire the opposition, the level that they have and how they do things, and you certainly learn from that. That inspires you to go to a different level, and that’s the level that City have brought to this league, which is unprecedented, because what they’ve done is unprecedented in this league.

on enjoying our busy schedule:The fun is being there on the grass and training. If that’s not fun, I think we have a problem. Then within that, you can find dreams, moments, synergies, and be a bit creative. Not to make it the same every single day, but I think the boys love to train and love to play, which is what you need.
on if the atmosphere could be hostile towards City:I don’t know, that’s something very individual and I don’t want to get into it.

on matching the intensity we had in the Community Shield:There is no difference in how we approach a game against any opposition. The level of opposition is going to dictate whether you have to do it for longer or shorter periods during the game, but the ambition and the purpose that we’re going to have on Sunday, that’s for sure.

on the importance of leading by more than one goal:When the margin is by one goal, especially with the level of the opponent that we play every three days, how difficult it is; they just need a moment, and it happened with Dortmund. They broke the press after eliminating one of our front players, and they have the capacity to pick out that player, that player has an individual action, and then it’s a goal. They didn’t do much more than that, but that was enough to get a point and you have to assume that. But again, overall, if we continue to generate what we’re generating, I’m very positive that things are going to be good.

on making Gyokeres a presence on the pitch beyond goals:I think the understanding he has with his teammates of the concepts and principles we’re trying to apply every single time. It comes with an emotional state and whatever the game requires, but I was very impressed with he way he played the other day.

on whether Saliba could have come on in the last two games:It depends, but obviously he hasn’t played football for a long time. He can play a certain amount of minutes, and we have to be really sure - especially in those kinds of games - that when he comes in, he can sustain a certain amount of minutes otherwise we won’t have enough subs or opportunities to make those subs. He’s training well, he’ll have minutes in the next few games, and then he’ll be able to prove what he’s already done, which is show what an unbelievable player he is.

on how many minutes Saliba is capable of playing at the moment:Now he’s got more training over the last week or 10 days, that will probably extend. But it depends on the type of game or exposure he will have throughout that game.
on whether Saliba has demanded to come back sooner:No, he hasn’t, I think he understands the situation - it’s quite obvious. But he’s desperate to play, that’s for sure.

on whether the fact we're defensively strong means we're too comfortable leading by one goal:I don’t think that’s something we do purposely. Sometimes you have to give credit to the opposition when they are able to do that. Especially in the last few minutes, they take so many chances so if we don't finish the game off, they still have the belief they can get something from the game. But the reality is that we have managed those kind of games really well in the last three or four years.

on dealing with man-to-man marking:We're trying to find the right solutions and adjusting to the profile of players we have and the types of challenges and jobs that the opponent will offer on the day. I think the understanding of what we have to do and the timings are much better. We have been much more efficient up to the point of actually scoring the goal, and making the most of the action.

on whether City's potential fate could overshadow the game:I hope that it doesn’t, because this is a process that is still open and not resolved and we don’t know what’s going to happen. When you have two teams at the level they are right now, with the quality of players on the pitch, it’s a massive game and one to enjoy.
on if we want to win titles on the pitch rather than being awarded them:That is the only thing we should focus our energy on, nothing else.

on how he has driven a culture and togetherness at the club in recent years:I have good people, I think there is no secret. If you have good people who love what they do, feel part of something, and you have good communication, there’s a probability that the culture will be strong. That is what we have been focusing on. On top of that, you need magnificent footballers, which is what we have, and someone who owns this club who prioritises those aspects and wants to create something unique here at Arsenal. We all support that idea.

on City's fluctuation in form:I don’t think it’s form or performance. I think they’ve been very unlucky with certain results, that’s my opinion and what I've seen analysing them. Enzo is a coach who understands the dynamics of the game so well, he is very smart to create changes and variations to adapt to the game in relation to what is happening, and he has a very clear idea and principles of how he wants to play. He’s good at transmitting that idea, and that’s why he has been so successful.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛前新闻发布会全记录
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳即将主场对阵曼城，主帅阿尔特塔出席赛前新闻发布会。
bodyZh: 阿尔特塔于周五下午出席了媒体见面会，为周日在酋长球场进行的英超对阵曼城的比赛做准备。
主帅探讨了戴维·拉亚和威廉·萨利巴的身体康复情况、与曼城的潜在争冠形势以及国际比赛日以来的球队表现。
请在下方阅读主帅的发言，或点击页面顶部的视频播放按钮观看完整新闻发布会。
关于拉亚的出场情况：我不知道，距离比赛还有几个小时，我们正在努力让所有人都恢复状态。
关于他是否在训练：是的，他们都在训练。萨卡也在训练。
关于拉亚是否在进行扑救练习：这一点我不太确定。
关于他是否有希望参与比赛：是的。
关于首发门将的姓氏是否以字母A结尾：很可能是。继续猜吧！
关于拉亚对我们的重要性以及尽全力让他复出的问题：是的，但这就是我们对每一位球员所做的事，我们以同样的方式对待他们。每个球员都有相同的心态，他们都希望能够出场，希望处于最佳状态，他们之间没有任何区别。
关于凯帕如果出场是否会想起联赛杯决赛：凯帕所拥有的经验已经不可思议了。你只要看看他效力过的球队、参与过的阵容以及赢得过的奖杯就知道了。所以，根本没有这回事。
关于曼城在英超判罚后表现挣扎：我不知道，这是他们的问题。我看到的是，当我观看他们比赛时，在很多场比赛中，他们获胜或者说他们的表现至少完全配得上战胜对手，但这就是足球——要赢得比赛。这体现了他们的踢球方式以及恩佐正在做的事情。
关于如果我们击败曼城，曼城的争冠是否就此结束：当我们主场对阵强队时，这在争冠过程中至关重要。我们深知这些主场比赛的重要性以及拉开差距的意义。但显然，第二点是，现在才11月，我们知道还有很长的路要走，但这对每一支球队来说都是一样的。
关于我们是否仍将曼城视为主要的争冠对手：我们不知道。我认为挑战属于我们，机会也属于我们。我们无法控制对手会做什么。我们只需要展现出最好的自己。我相信周日的氛围将会不可思议，我们需要享受并拥抱这种类型的比赛，全力以赴。
关于尽管对我们进攻有所批评，但在他执教下进球数即将达到700个：这是数据，人们会有看法，或者这方面会有不同的时刻，但我并不担心。我关心的是让球队做好准备，拥有最佳的心态、能量、身体条件和清晰的思路来击败曼城。就是这样。
关于我们最近64脚射门只进了4球：让我们继续创造更多机会，你们就会看到我们能进多少球。我并不担心这个问题。
关于恩佐的性格是否体现在他的球队中：我私下认识恩佐，但没那么深入去描述他。我认为所有与他共事过的人都认为他是一个了不起的人，一个热爱并呼吸着足球的人，非常有分析能力。他曾是一名伟大的球员，而且在如此年轻的执教生涯中已经取得了非常令人印象深刻的成就。所以我只能描述我所看到的以及我对他的微薄了解，这一切都超级积极。
关于进攻时边后卫的站位：根据对手的表现，我们需要移动，占据我们认为能够打击对手的空间和联系。我们越不可预测，事情就会越容易。
关于试图卫冕冠军的不同之处：再次做到这一点的渴望更加强烈，想要拥有相同的感觉，再次一起经历那些时刻。每个人每周都付出令人难以置信的努力，给我们机会备战比赛、分析对手、在小伙子们周围营造正确的氛围并真正赢得比赛。如果你周复一周地这样做，你就在建立一些东西，能够给你机会再次经历这些时刻，我们都渴望再次拥有它们。
关于进球多少是否重要：我当然更喜欢进5个、6个或7个球来取胜。我会更享受比赛，尤其是最后几分钟。小伙子们也会玩得更开心。我认为进球最终是创造看台上良好感觉、喜悦、幸福和庆祝的事情。除了赢球，这是足球中最重要的事情。
关于我们球员与曼城球员之间的相互尊重：你钦佩对手，他们的水平以及他们做事的方式，你肯定会从中学习。这会激励你达到不同的水平，而这就是曼城为这个联赛带来的水平，这是前所未有的，因为他们在这个联赛中所做的事情是前所未有的。
关于享受我们紧凑的赛程：乐趣就在于在草坪上和训练中。如果这都不是乐趣，我认为我们就遇到麻烦了。在此期间，你可以找到梦想、时刻、协同作用，并变得有点创造力。不是每天都一模一样，但我认为小伙子们喜欢训练，喜欢比赛，这正是你所需要的。
关于对曼城的气氛是否会充满敌意：我不知道，这是非常个人的事情，我不想涉足。
关于保持我们在社区盾杯时的强度：我们对待任何对手比赛的方法都没有区别。对手的水平将决定你在比赛中是需要长时间还是短时间内做到这一点，但我们在周日将拥有的雄心和目标是毋庸置疑的。
关于领先不止一球的重要性：当优势只有一球时，尤其是面对我们每三天就要交手一次的对手的水平，这是多么困难；他们只需要一个机会，多特蒙德就是这样。他们在摆脱我们的一名前锋后打破了逼抢，他们有能力找到那名球员，那名球员完成个人动作，然后就是进球。他们并没有做太多其他事情，但这就足以拿到一分，你必须接受这一点。但话说回来，总体而言，如果我们继续创造我们正在创造的东西，我非常乐观，事情会好起来的。
关于让约克雷斯在进球之外在场上发挥存在感：我认为他与队友之间对我们每次都试图应用的理念和原则有着默契。这伴随着情感状态以及比赛所需的任何东西，但我对他前几天的踢球方式印象深刻。
关于萨利巴是否本可在过去两场比赛中替补出场：这要看情况，但显然他已经很久没有踢球了。他可以踢一定时间的比赛，我们必须非常确定——尤其是在那种类型的比赛中——当他上场时，他能够坚持一定的时间，否则我们将没有足够的换人名额或机会来进行这些换人。他训练得很好，在接下来的几场比赛中他会得到出场时间，然后他将能够证明他已经做过的事情，那就是展示他是一名多么不可思议的球员。
关于萨利巴目前能够踢多长时间：现在他在过去一周到十天里有了更多的训练，时间可能会延长。但这取决于他在整场比赛中面临的比赛类型或对抗强度。
关于萨利巴是否曾要求更快复出：不，他没有，我认为他理解这种情况——这是显而易见的。但他非常渴望上场踢球，那是肯定的。
关于我们防守稳固是否意味着我们对一球领先过于安心：我不认为这是我们故意做的事情。有时候当对手能够做到这一点时，你必须称赞对手。特别是在最后几分钟，他们冒了那么多险，所以如果我们不杀死比赛，他们仍然坚信自己能从比赛中有所收获。但现实是，在过去的三四年里，我们处理这种比赛的方式真的很好。
关于应对人盯人防守：我们正在努力寻找正确的解决方案，并根据我们拥有的球员特点以及对手当天将提供的挑战和任务进行调整。我认为对于我们必须做什么的理解以及时机要好得多。在真正进球并充分利用这一动作之前，我们的效率要高得多。
关于曼城的潜在命运是否会掩盖这场比赛：我希望不会，因为这是一个仍在进行中、尚未解决且我们不知道会发生什么的流程。当两支球队目前都处于这种水平、球场上拥有这种质量的球员时，这是一场重大的比赛，也是一场值得享受的比赛。
关于我们是想在球场上赢得冠军而不是被授予冠军：这是我们唯一应该集中精力的事，没有别的。
关于他在近年是如何推动俱乐部的文化和凝聚力：我有优秀的人才，我认为没有什么秘诀。如果你有优秀的、热爱自己所做的事情、觉得自己是其中一部分的人，并且你有良好的沟通，那么文化就会强大的概率就会很高。这就是我们一直关注的重点。除此之外，你需要宏伟的足球运动员，而这正是我们所拥有的，还有一位拥有这家俱乐部的主人，他优先考虑这些方面，并希望在阿森纳创造一些独特的东西。我们都支持这个想法。
关于曼城状态的波动：我不认为是状态或表现的问题。我认为他们在某些结果上非常不幸，这是我的看法，也是我分析他们后看到的。恩佐是一位非常懂球的教练，他非常聪明，能够根据发生的事情进行改变和调整以适应比赛，他对于如何踢球有着非常清晰的想法和原则。他善于传达这种想法，这就是他如此成功的原因。

items.titleEn: Mikel: “We need to enjoy and embrace this game”
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta is eagerly anticipating Sunday’s showdown at Emirates Stadium, where we host Manchester City in the Premier League
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta is eagerly anticipating Sunday’s showdown at Emirates Stadium, where we host Manchester City in the Premier League at 4.30pm.
Our title defence continues with us currently six points clear the top of the division, with Brighton & Hove Albion ahead of City on goal difference.
We’ve of course had a number of tight title races with City in years gone by, but now have the tantalising prospect of going nine points ahead of Enzo Maresca’s side.
In his pre-match press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Friday, our manager was asked if we still see City as our main title rivals.

“We don't know, I think the challenge is for us and the opportunity is for us,” he said. “We cannot control what the opponents are going to do. We just need to give ourselves the best version. I'm sure the atmosphere is going to be incredible on Sunday and we need to enjoy and embrace those kind of games and go for it.

“When we play the home games against big teams, that becomes crucial in the title challenge. We know how important those home games are and to make the difference. But obviously, we're in November and we know how long still we have to play, but that's the same for every single team.”
Like Maresca, Arteta worked under Pep Guardiola during his time at City, and spoke about the former’s personality and how much his team’s identity is reflected by that.

“Well, I know Enzo personally, but not that much to describe him,” he said. “I think it's everybody that has worked with him thinks that is a phenomenal guy. Someone that loves and breathes football. That is very, very analytical. He was a great player already and what he's done in his managerial career already, so young, is very, very impressive. So I cannot describe, only what I've seen and the little bits that I know of him, which is everything super positive, obviously.”

City were held to a 2-2 draw at home to Napoli in the UEFA Champions League on Tuesday night following Saturday’s 1-1 draw at home with Fulham, which came after their 3-1 defeat away to Nottingham Forest.

Commenting on their fluctuation in form, Mikel continued: “I don’t think it’s form or performance. I think they’ve been very unlucky with certain results, that’s my opinion based on what I’ve analysed of them. Enzo is a coach who understands the dynamics of the game so well, the changes and variations to adapt to the game, and he has clear ideas and principles of how he wants to play. He’s good at transmitting those ideas, and that’s why he has been so successful.”
items.author: Stephen Wright
items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔：“我们需要享受并拥抱这场比赛”
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔期待周日在酋长球场对阵曼城的英超焦点战。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔正热切期待周日下午4点半在酋长球场进行的对决，届时我们将在英超联赛中主场迎战曼城。
我们的争冠征程仍在继续，目前我们在积分榜上领先榜首6分，布赖顿因净胜球优势排在曼城之前。
过去几年我们当然与曼城经历过多次激烈的争冠战，而现在我们迎来了将对阵Enzo Maresca球队的优势扩大到9分的诱人前景。
周五在索布哈 realty 训练中心举行的赛前新闻发布会上，我们的主教练被问及是否仍视曼城为主要争冠对手。
“我们不知道，我认为挑战和机会都在我们自己身上，”他说。“我们无法控制对手会做什么。我们只需要展现出最好的自己。我相信周日的氛围将会非常不可思议，我们需要享受并拥抱这类比赛，全力以赴。”
“当我们主场对阵强队时，这在争冠战中变得至关重要。我们知道这些主场比赛有多么重要以及它们如何拉开差距。但显然，现在才11月，我们知道还有很长的路要走，不过对每支球队来说都是一样的。”
与Maresca一样，阿尔特塔曾在曼城效力于瓜德罗普麾下，他谈到了前者的性格以及他的球队身上在多大程度上反映了这一点。
“嗯，我个人认识恩佐，但还没到能很好描述他的程度，”他说。“我认为所有和他共事过的人都觉得他是个了不起的人。一个热爱并呼吸着足球的人。非常非常有分析能力。他曾经是一名伟大的球员，而在他如此年轻的执教生涯中所取得的成就也非常非常令人印象深刻。所以我无法描述，只能说根据我所看到的以及对他略知一二的事情，显然全都是超级积极的。”
曼城在周二晚上的欧洲冠军联赛主场2-2战平那不勒斯，此前他们在周六主场1-1战平富勒姆，而在此之前他们客场1-3不敌诺丁汉森林。
在评论他们近期状态的起伏时，米克尔继续说道：“我不认为这是状态或表现的问题。根据我对他们的分析，我认为他们在某些结果上非常不幸，这是我的看法。恩佐是一位非常理解比赛动态、能够适应比赛变化与调整的教练，他对自己想怎么踢有清晰的想法和原则。他善于传达这些想法，这就是他为什么如此成功的原因。”

items.titleEn: Arteta on whether Raya or Saka will be fit to face Man City
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta spoke about goalkeeper David Raya's fitness in his pre-Manchester City press conference
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has suggested that David Raya may be fit enough to feature in our crunch Premier League clash against Manchester City on Sunday.

David picked up an injury claiming a corner during last weekend's 2-2 draw against Newcastle United and was forced off, with Kepa Arrizabalaga donning the gloves in his place. That was also the case for Tuesday's Champions League game against Borussia Dortmund, with Mikel indicating before the game that, thankfully, the three-time Premier League Golden Glove winner shouldn't be out for long.
But with games coming thick and fast and Enzo Maresca's City side next on the packed schedule, has there been enough time for David to recover sufficiently for the big game?
When asked if there was hope, Mikel suggested "yes" before adding, "we still have a few hours before the game so we're just trying to get everybody back.

"That's what we do with every single player. We treat them in the same way, and every player has the same mindset. They want to be available, they want to be in the best possible condition, and there's no difference between them."
The only other injury concerns for Mikel surround Bukayo Saka and Martin Zubimendi, who picked up muscle injuries. However in better news, Mikel revealed that Bukayo is back in training again
Max Dowman is allowed to play in the Premier League again after serving his three-match suspension following his red card at Fleetwood Town.
items.author: Jonathon Rogers
items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔谈拉亚和萨卡能否出战曼城
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔在赛前发布会上谈到了门将拉亚的身体恢复情况。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔暗示，大卫·拉亚可能已经足够健康，能够参加我们周日对阵曼城的英超关键战。
在上周末2比2战平纽卡斯尔联的比赛中，大卫在争抢角球时受伤并被换下，凯帕·阿里萨瓦拉加替补登场。周二对阵多特蒙德的欧冠比赛也是如此，米克尔赛前表示，幸运的是这位三届英超金手套得主不会缺阵太久。
但由于赛程密集，接下来将对阵曼城，大卫有足够的时间为这场大战充分恢复吗？
当被问及是否有希望时，米克尔暗示“有”，并补充道：“距离比赛还有几个小时，我们正在努力让所有人都恢复状态。”
“我们对每一名球员都是如此。我们以同样的方式对待他们，每个球员都有相同的心态。他们希望能够上场，希望处于最佳状态，他们之间没有区别。”
米克尔仅有的其他伤病隐患围绕着遭遇肌肉拉伤的布卡约·萨卡和马丁·祖比门迪。不过好消息是，米克尔透露布卡约已经恢复训练。
在弗利特伍德镇吃红牌停赛三场期满后，马克斯·多曼获准再次在英超联赛中出场。

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳将于周日在酋长球场主场迎战曼城，球队已完成赛前备战。
bodyZh: 我们在周日下午重返英超赛场，将迎来与曼城的重头戏，你可以通过我们最新的训练图集了解球队的备战情况。
上周末我们在客场2比2战平纽卡斯尔，这使得我们在英超积分榜上的领先优势扩大到6分，领先于曼城和排名第二的布莱顿。
在上赛季击败周日的对手夺得冠军后，我们在8月的社区盾杯中延续了胜利。在这个有望营造出轰动氛围的酋长球场，我们将再次寻求战胜现代宿敌。
浏览下方由俱乐部摄影师斯图尔特·麦克法兰（Stuart MacFarlane）拍摄的图集，看看我们在索巴地产训练中心（Sobha Realty Training Centre）为这场比赛做了哪些准备：

items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners will look to bounce back against the Cherries
bodyEn: Our young Gunners will look to bounce back in the Under-18s Premier League as they host Bournemouth at Sobha Realty Training Centre on Saturday, November 28. Kick-off is scheduled for 12pm (UK time).

Following a heavy defeat away to Chelsea last time out, our under-18s will be eager to put things right and return to winning ways. Before that result, they enjoyed an impressive six-game winning streak in the league.
THE OPPOSITION
Bournemouth currently sit ninth in the Under-18s Premier League table and head to north London having drawn their last two league fixtures.
Their last victory came towards the end of October, when they secured a 2-0 win over Birmingham City.
In the Under-18s Premier League Cup, the Cherries finished bottom of their group, drawing one and losing two of their three matches.
HOW TO FOLLOW
The action gets underway at 12pm (UK time), with live updates available on our Academy X account and a full match report to follow shortly after the final whistle.
After the game, don't miss exclusive interviews with one of our academy coaches and young Gunners, alongside highlights of all the key action, on The Arsenal app and Arsenal.com.
items.author: Brian Matovu
items.titleZh: U18前瞻：阿森纳对阵伯恩茅斯
items.summaryZh: 年轻的枪手们希望在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中重回胜利轨道。
bodyZh: 11月28日星期六，我们的年轻枪手将在U18英超联赛中坐镇索布哈地产训练基地迎战伯恩茅斯，比赛定于英国时间中午12点开球。
在上一场客场惨败给切尔西之后，我们的U18梯队渴望拨乱反正，重返胜利轨道。在此之前，他们在联赛中曾取得过令人瞩目的六连胜。
对手情况
伯恩茅斯目前在U18英超联赛积分榜上排名第九，他们带着联赛两连平的战绩前往北伦敦。
他们的上一场胜利发生在10月底，当时他们以2-0击败了伯明翰城。
在U18英超杯中，樱桃军团在小组中垫底，三场比赛取得一平两负。
如何关注比赛
比赛将于英国时间中午12点开始，您可以通过我们的青训学院X账号获取实时战报，终场哨响后不久将发布完整的比赛报告。
比赛结束后，千万不要错过在阿森纳官方App和Arsenal.com上观看我们的一位青训教练和年轻枪手的独家采访，以及所有精彩画面的集锦。

items.titleEn: Premier League: 10 things to look out for this weekend

bodyEn: Nottingham Forest’s last couple of seasons have been a story of good runs and bad runs, but it may help to know that last season’s encounters with Chelsea both presaged changes of fortune. After they lost to Chelsea in October, a seventh defeat in 10 winless games, Forest’s form improved and they won seven of their next 12 in all competitions. But after beating Chelsea in May, their seventh victory in a 10-game unbeaten run, Forest’s form dipped dramatically and they have won only twice since. Oliver Glasner’s criticism of players whose “standards [are] not high enough” is clearly designed to raise them. Time will tell if it has worked but the key man this week is one who should have no issues with motivation and whose English is at least decent. Liam Delap, facing the side that signed and swiftly discarded him, could really trouble Wesley Fofana and Levi Colwill. The Chelsea centre-back pairing were described as playing like “two novices” by Jamie Carragher after they were outfought by Dominic Calvert-Lewin last week. “Until they sign that dominant centre-back and leader, they’ve got absolutely no chance of achieving anything,” Carragher concluded. Simon Burnton
Nottingham Forest v Chelsea, Friday 8pm (all times GMT)

When Leeds recruited Dominic Calvert-Lewin on a free transfer during the summer of 2025 it is fair to say many of their fans were underwhelmed. Now though the news that the England centre-forward has penned a contract extension at Elland Road is a cause for celebration in West Yorkshire. Calvert-Lewin had proved somewhat injury-prone at his former club, Everton, yet Daniel Farke evidently knew what he was doing. The newly robust 29-year-old has scored 18 goals in 46 Premier League appearances for Leeds, 17 arriving in the last 36 games. With Calvert-Lewin now having signed a new, improved deal extending until 2029, attention is turning to Farke’s own contract. The German’s current agreement expires next summer but renewal talks have been under way for some time and, for the moment at least, the normally open Leeds manager has turned coy. “I’ve fallen in love with the club,” said Farke ahead of his upwardly mobile team’s home meeting with Coventry. “But I’m not willing to speak about my future.” Louise Taylor
Leeds v Coventry, Saturday 3pm

Mauricio Pochettino will send out his first Manchester United XI at Old Trafford on Saturday hoping Senne Lammens’ errors for the season are over. The fumble of a simple aerial ball late on at Sporting that allowed Luis Suárez to salvage a point on Wednesday was dismal from the goalkeeper despite his head coach’s protestations that the backline as a collective was at fault for allowing the opening. Karl Darlow, United’s second choice, has Premier League experience after a stint as Leeds’ first choice towards the end of last season but has played only 30 games in all divisions in the past three years. That means, probably, that Pochettino will retain Lammens but if more mistakes follow then the Wales international Darlow may be handed his chance. Jamie Jackson
Manchester United v Brentford, Saturday 3pm

Being forced from the field with “stud marks all the way down the back of his calf” after a clash with Tottenham’s Mohammed Kudus towards the end of last weekend’s match led to Leif Davis missing his first Premier League minutes of the season. It left Ipswich’s central defensive pairing of Issa Diop and Dara O’Shea as their only players to have been on the pitch for the entirety of the league campaign so far. O’Shea said this week of playing with Diop that “the more games we play with each other, obviously the better we’ll become as a pair”. They’re being given the best possible chance, even if Ipswich are yet to keep a clean sheet and have already conceded 22 goals, from an opposition xG of 21.82. Only the league’s bottom two have conceded a higher xG. More surprising is that Aston Villa have the next highest tally, with 18.56. Tuesday, when Villa lost 1-0 at Galatasaray, marked out a month since their last win. They have drawn three and scored in only two of their six outings. Ipswich may be just two points and two places outside the bottom three, but a win would put these teams level. SB
Ipswich v Aston Villa, Saturday 5.30pm

“We are having a great week,” Virgil van Dijk said after Liverpool followed up their 4-0 dismantling of Manchester United with a 3-0 win at Club Brugge that reinforced the strides being made by Alexander Isak, Florian Wirtz and Andoni Iraola’s team overall. Liverpool’s week contrasts starkly with their local rivals. Everton suffered the heaviest defeat and produced arguably the worst performance of David Moyes’s second spell in charge on Monday when going down 4-0 at Brentford. James Tarkowski’s red card made no difference, so superior were Keith Andrews’s side from the start, but the absence of the Everton captain could be keenly felt on Sunday. Liverpool won the first Merseyside derby at Hill Dickinson Stadium last season from a 100th-minute corner, capitalising on disruption to Everton’s central defence when Jarrad Branthwaite went off injured. Without Tarkowski the hosts may be vulnerable again. Jake O’Brien could get his long-awaited chance to stake a claim as Branthwaite’s partner in the most demanding circumstances. Andy Hunter
Everton v Liverpool, Sunday noon

Georginio Rutter offered an insight into the Fabian Hürzeler effect at Brighton this week. “He has changed the mentality of some of the players: he wants us to run and give 100% – we did that last season but not as hard as he wanted,” said the Frenchman. “Some new players have come in and given us a new vibe.” While the likes of Luka Vuskovic – who surpassed Rutter as Brighton’s record signing in the summer – and Chema Andrés have quickly established themselves as first choices, the 24-year-old forward who joined from Leeds in 2024 has fallen behind Greek teenager Charalampos Kostoulas since recovering from a foot injury. Rutter started in the defeat by Hull last week but missed the opportunity to score his first Premier League goal in 13 appearances despite some promising moments. He may have to make do with a place among the substitutes again when Newcastle visit on Sunday. “I want to play in every game,” said Rutter. “When I’m on the bench, I’m not happy. However, I know it is part of football and I will always give everything.” Ed Aarons
Brighton v Newcastle, Sunday 2.05pm

The bad news for Spurs fans is that their trip to Sunderland coincides with engineering work prompting the closure of the train line between King’s Cross and Peterborough. It means visiting supporters travelling by rail must head from St Pancras to Bedford before catching a rail replacement bus to Peterborough. The only feasible service departs London at 6.33am, arriving in Sunderland at 1.07pm and involves three changes. The return journey features four changes but, at six hours, is marginally swifter. At the time of writing the cheapest return ticket was £180.30. Such rail disruptions on Sundays are depressingly common and raise awkward questions about the country’s transport infrastructure outside the capital and, consequently, the UK’s suitability to host the men’s Euros in 2028 and the 2035 Women’s World Cup. More immediately, Spurs hope to capitalise on the injury-induced absence of Sunderland’s Brian Brobbey and Granit Xhaka while home fans are intrigued to see how Xhaka’s understudy, the immensely promising 20-year-old Jules Ahoka, fares in a central midfield duel with Sandro Tonali. LT
Sunderland v Tottenham, Sunday 2.05pm

Crystal Palace have announced plans to create a singing section at Selhurst Park for their Carabao Cup quarter-final against Sunderland next month in an attempt to make up for the absence of the Holmesdale Fanatics. Thomas Frank will need all the help he can get on Sunday against Hull and for the rest of the season if Palace are going to rouse themselves from the foot of the Premier League. Not since a 0-0 draw against West Ham in April have Palace kept a clean sheet in the league at Selhurst Park. They will come up against a highly organised Hull team, full of confidence after their win over Brighton last weekend. The bad news for Palace is that Frank won just four of his last 22 home matches in charge of Brentford and Tottenham. That statistic needs to improve drastically if Palace are to climb the table. EA
Crystal Palace v Hull, Sunday 2.05pm

The quiet progress Fulham have made under Álvaro Arbeloa has been helped by David Affengruber’s emergence in central defence. The Austria international joined from Elche at the end of the transfer window and has been key to the side’s defensive improvement after a shaky start to the season. Fulham have only conceded six goals in Affengruber’s first eight appearances and have found it easier to play a high line since partnering the 25-year-old with Calvin Bassey. However, the sturdiness will be put to the test when Fulham host Bournemouth on Sunday. Evanilson has eight goals in his last nine appearances. The striker’s battle with Affengruber will be absorbing. Jacob Steinberg
Fulham v Bournemouth, Sunday 2.05pm

Plenty of attention this season has focused on the battle between Kai Havertz and Viktor Gyökeres to be Arsenal’s leading man, with the Sweden striker still expected to be on the bench for Manchester City’s visit to the Emirates Stadium despite scoring against Borussia Dortmund in midweek. With Noni Madueke nailed on for the right flank, Mikel Arteta must decide whether Christos Tzolis or Eberechi Eze starts on the left and it appears the England forward may have the advantage. Tzolis has yet to convince he is an upgrade on Leandro Trossard or Gabriel Martinelli and is yet to score in 13 appearances since joining from Club Brugge in the summer. Eze, who scored against Newcastle last week on only his third Premier League start of the season and already has three goals in all competitions, offers a different option for a team struggling to find the back of the net despite being six points clear at the top. Arsenal have not managed three goals in a Premier League match since the opening day against Coventry. Arteta will hope to target a leaky City defence that has already conceded 14 league goals. EA
Arsenal v Manchester City, Sunday 4.30pm

items.titleZh: 英超周末看点：阿森纳迎战曼城，多场焦点对决上演
items.summaryZh: 英超联赛本周末迎来多场焦点战，其中包括阿森纳主场对阵曼城的强强对话。
bodyZh: 诺丁汉森林过去几个赛季的表现一直在连胜和连败之间交替，但了解上赛季他们与切尔西的交锋或许有助于把握命运的转折。10月份输给切尔西后，森林的状态有所回升，在各项赛事接下来的12场比赛中赢了7场。然而在5月份击败切尔西之后，他们的状态急剧下滑，自那以后仅赢了两场。奥利弗·格拉斯纳对球员“标准不够高”的批评显然旨在提高他们的要求。时间会证明这是否有效，但本周的关键人物是一位不缺乏动力且英语至少还不错的球员。利安·德拉普面对曾签下又很快放弃他的球队，可能会给韦斯利·福法纳和莱维·科尔维尔制造不小的麻烦。切尔西的中卫组合在上周被多米尼克·卡尔弗特-勒温击溃后，被杰米·卡拉格形容得像“两个新手”。卡拉格总结道：“在他们签下那个具有统治力的中卫和领袖之前，他们绝对没有任何机会取得成就。”西蒙·伯恩顿
诺丁汉森林对阵切尔西，周五晚上8点（所有时间均为格林威治标准时间）

当利兹联在2025年夏天以自由转会方式签下多米尼克·卡尔弗特-勒温时，可以说许多球迷并没有感到过于兴奋。然而现在，这位英格兰中锋在埃兰路球场续约的消息成为了西约克郡庆祝的理由。卡尔弗特-勒温在老东家埃弗顿曾有些容易受伤，但丹尼尔·法尔克显然知道自己在做什么。这位重新恢复强壮的29岁球员在代表利兹联出战的46场英超联赛中打入18球，其中17球是在最近36场比赛中攻入的。随着卡尔弗特-勒温签下了一份延长至2029年的新改进合同，人们的注意力转向了法尔克自己的合同。这位德国教头的现有协议将于明年夏天到期，但续约谈判已经进行了一段时间，至少目前这位通常很坦率的利兹联主帅变得含糊其辞。“我已经爱上了这家俱乐部，”法尔克在球队主场迎战势头强劲的考文垂之前说道，“但我不想谈论我的未来。”路易丝·泰勒
利兹联对阵考文垂，周六下午3点

毛里西奥·波切蒂诺将于周六在老特拉福德排出他执教曼联的第一套首发阵容，希望森内·拉姆ENS本赛季的失误已经结束。周三在客场对阵葡萄牙体育的比赛中，他在比赛尾声对一次简单的空中球处理不当，导致路易斯·苏亚雷斯扳平比分，这名门将的表现令人沮丧，尽管他的主教练坚称防线集体在允许对手首开纪录时负有责任。卡尔·达洛作为曼联的二号门将，在上赛季末段担任利兹联主力期间积累了英超经验，但在过去三年里他在所有赛事中仅出场30次。这意味着波切蒂诺很可能会继续信任拉姆ENS，但如果接下来的失误不断，这位威尔士国脚达洛可能会获得机会。杰米·杰克逊
曼联对阵布伦特福德，周六下午3点

上周末比赛接近尾声时，莱夫·戴维斯在与托特纳姆热刺的穆罕默德·库杜斯的拼抢后被迫离场，小腿后侧布满鞋钉印，这导致他错失了本赛季至今仅有的全勤英超时间。这使得伊普斯维奇的中卫组合伊萨·迪奥普和达拉·奥谢成为队中仅有的打满目前全部联赛时间的球员。奥谢本周谈到与迪奥普搭档时表示：“我们一起踢的比赛越多，我们作为搭档自然就会变得越好。”他们正在获得最好的机会，尽管伊普斯维奇尚未保持零封，并且已经失球22个，而对手的预期进球（xG）为21.82。只有联赛倒数前两名的球队失球预期更高。更令人惊讶的是阿斯顿维拉，他们的预期失球高达18.56。周日本场比赛，维拉在客场0-1不敌加拉塔萨雷，标志着他们自上次赢球以来已经过去了一个月。他们在最近六场比赛中平了三场，且只有两场取得进球。伊普斯维奇可能仅领先降级区两分并排在倒数第三，但一场胜利将使这些球队积分持平。西蒙·伯恩顿
伊普斯维奇对阵阿斯顿维拉，周六下午5点30分

“我们正经历着一个伟大的星期，”范戴克在利物浦4-0大胜曼联以及客场3-0击败布鲁日俱乐部后说道，这场胜利进一步巩固了亚历山大·伊萨克、弗洛里安·维尔茨以及安多尼·伊拉奥拉球队整体取得的进步。利物浦本周的表现与同城死敌形成了鲜明对比。埃弗顿在周一客场0-4不敌布伦特福德的比赛中，遭遇了大卫·莫耶斯二度执教以来的最惨失利和可以说是最差表现。詹姆斯·塔科夫斯基的红牌并没有改变什么，基思·安德鲁斯的球队从一开始就占据绝对优势，但在周日的比赛中，埃弗顿队长的缺阵可能会让人深切感受到。上赛季，利物浦在希尔迪金森球场进行的首次默seyside德比中，利用杰兰特·布兰斯韦特因伤离场导致埃弗顿中卫防线混乱的机会，在第100分钟通过角球绝杀取胜。没有了塔科夫斯基，主队可能再次变得脆弱。杰克·奥布里安可能会迎来期盼已久的机会，在最苛刻的环境下证明自己能够成为布兰斯韦特的搭档。安迪·亨特
埃弗顿对阵利物浦，周日中午12点

热尔松·鲁特尔本周透露了法比安·许尔策尔在布赖顿带来的影响。“他改变了一些球员的心态：他希望我们奔跑并付出100%的努力——我们上赛季也这样做了，但没有他要求的那么努力，”这位法国人说，“一些新球员的到来给我们带来了新的氛围。”虽然像卢卡·武什科维奇（他在夏天超越鲁特尔成为布赖顿的标王）和切马·安德雷斯迅速确立了主力位置，但这位2024年从利兹联加盟的24岁前锋在从脚伤中恢复后，已经落后于希腊少年查拉兰博斯·科斯图拉斯。鲁特尔在上周输给赫尔城的比赛中首发出场，尽管有一些有威胁的表现，但错失了在13次出场中攻入个人英超首球的机会。当纽卡斯尔于周日来访时，他可能不得不再次接受替补席上的位置。“我想踢每一场比赛，”鲁特尔说，“当我在替补席上时，我不高兴。然而，我知道这是足球的一部分，我总是会付出一切。”埃德·阿伦斯
布赖顿对阵纽卡斯尔，周日下午2点05分

对于热刺球迷来说，坏消息是他们前往桑德兰的客场之旅正好赶上工程施工，导致国王十字车站和彼得伯勒之间的铁路线关闭。这意味着乘坐铁路出行的客场球迷必须从圣潘克拉斯前往贝德福德，然后转乘铁路替代巴士前往彼得伯勒。唯一可行的班次于伦敦时间上午6点33分出发，下午1点07分到达桑德兰，中途需要换乘三次。返程需要换乘四次，但历时六小时，略微快一些。在撰写本文时，最便宜的往返票价为180.30英镑。周日的这种铁路中断令人沮丧地普遍存在，并引发了关于首都以外国家交通基础设施以及因此英国是否适合举办2028年男子欧洲杯和2035年女子世界杯的尴尬问题。更直接的是，热刺希望利用桑德兰的布莱恩·布罗贝里和格兰尼特·扎卡因伤缺阵的机会，而主场球迷则很想看看扎卡的替补、极具前途的20岁小将朱尔斯·阿霍卡在与桑德罗·托纳利的中央中场对决中表现如何。路易丝·泰勒
桑德兰对阵托特纳姆热刺，周日下午2点05分

水晶宫宣布计划在下个月对阵桑德兰的联赛杯四分之一决赛中，在塞尔赫斯特公园球场设立一个助威区，以此来弥补霍姆斯特德狂热球迷缺席的影响。如果水晶宫想要从英超积分榜底端振作起来，托马斯·弗兰克在周日对阵赫尔城以及本赛季剩余的比赛中将需要得到所有能得到的帮助。自4月份对阵西汉姆联0-0战平以来，水晶宫在塞尔赫斯特公园的联赛中就没有保持过零封。他们将面对一支组织严密的赫尔城队，在经历上周末击败布赖顿后，他们信心十足。对水晶宫来说，坏消息是弗兰克在执教布伦特福德和热刺的最后22场主场比赛中仅赢了4场。如果水晶宫想要在积分榜上爬升，这一统计数据急剧需要改善。埃德·阿伦斯
水晶宫对阵赫尔城，周日下午2点05分

富勒姆在阿尔瓦罗·阿贝罗亚带领下取得的低调进步，得益于大卫·阿芬格鲁伯在防守核心位置的崛起。这位奥地利国脚在转会窗口关闭时从埃尔切加盟，并在球队开局动荡后成为防守改善的关键。阿芬格鲁伯在前八次出场中仅失六球，并且自从这位25岁球员与卡尔文·巴松搭档后，球队踢高位防线变得更加容易。然而，周日富勒姆主场迎战伯恩茅斯时，这种稳固性将受到严峻考验。埃凡尼尔松在最近九场比赛中打入八球。这位前锋与阿芬格鲁伯之间的对决将十分引人入胜。雅各布·斯坦伯格
富勒姆对阵伯恩茅斯，周日下午2点05分

本赛季，很多注意力都集中在哈弗茨和维克托·哲凯赖什争夺阿森纳主力前锋位置的较量上，尽管周中在对阵多特蒙德的比赛中取得进球，这位瑞典前锋预计在曼城访问酋长球场时仍将坐在替补席上。随着诺尼·马杜埃凯锁定右路，米克尔·阿尔特塔必须决定由克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯还是埃贝雷奇·埃泽首发出场，而这位英格兰前锋似乎占据优势。齐奥利斯尚未证明自己比莱昂德罗·特罗萨德或加布里埃尔·马丁内利更具升级效果，并且自夏天从布鲁日俱乐部加盟以来，在13次出场中尚未进球。埃泽在上周末仅仅是他本赛季的第三次英超首发中就攻破纽卡斯尔大门，并且在各项赛事中已经打入三球，为这支在积分榜榜首领先6分却依然难以破门的球队提供了不同的选择。自对阵考文垂的揭幕战以来，阿森纳在单场英超联赛中还未能打入三球。阿尔特塔将希望瞄准曼城漏洞百出的防线，他们本赛季联赛已经丢了14球。埃德·阿伦斯
阿森纳对阵曼城，周日下午4点30分

items.summaryEn: The French side earned their first group win over troubled German giants as Bellingham and Betis also caught the eyeBayern Munich have hit a snagging point, with injuries wracking Vincent Kompany’s squad just as the head coach returns to work following his own health scare. bodyEn: Bayern Munich have hit a snagging point, with injuries wracking Vincent Kompany’s squad just as the head coach returns to work following his own health scare. For Lille’s winner, to exact Bayern’s first loss of the season, Aleksandar Pavlović had an own goal for the ages, desperately chasing back to then somehow direct the ball into his own net. Bayern are 15th in the Champions League table, and with Harry Kane out until well into 2027 and 18-year-old Lennart Karl asked to lead the line, resources are stretched. Jamal Musiala, subject of club grandees Uli Hoeness and Karl-Heinz Rummenigge’s gripes over his contract in light of his neurological condition, could also play only 15 minutes.

Praise instead is due to Lille, coached by Davide Ancelotti to their first win of the group stage. They are captained by 36-year-old Benjamin André, who played one of the best matches of his long career. “Underrated” in the view of Ancelotti, who worked at Bayern under his father, Carlo. “Tonight was something special, we played like a monster.”

Soccer’s world-leading content delivery machine continues to supply a high grade of entertainment. While critics carp against the group stage’s baggy format, Manchester United have supplied the thrills, the spills, the pratfalls. Following the pathos of Atlético Madrid and Como, a comedy of errors at Sporting, with Senne Lammens saving a penalty from Luis Suárez, being unable to save Suárez’s next spot-kick and then dropping the ball for the same player to equalise for a 2-2 scoreline that undersold the chaos. United’s second goal, Bruno Fernandes’s second, also came via farcical means, beating Kaique Pereira, the Sporting keeper, after a bobble off a divot in the Estádio José Alvalade’s surface that Fernandes had himself created when trying to keep his footing. A word, too, for Szymon Marciniak, who gave a strange, overly fussy referee’s performance, ruling out two seemingly legitimate United goals.

Were United improved? It was difficult to gauge. “With a performance like today it’s the best medicine to prepare the next game,” said Mauricio Pochettino, possibly still jet-lagged yet already deep in the United reeds. His team are 19th in both the Champions League and Premier League.

Kevin De Bruyne’s return to the Etihad brought yearning from both player and former club. Manchester City’s struggles continue and De Bruyne, now 35, is not performing as desired for Napoli, while those from within City continue to push the idea of business as usual amid the limbo of those guilty charges, two empty tiers of the renovated stadium cast telling shadows. Playing in an unfamiliar orange kit for reasons of partnership with a fashion firm best known for football casual “clobber” only added to the surrealism.

“When you don’t win, you question everything,” Erling Haaland said following a 2-2 draw rescued by some Rayan Cherki magic. Among those questions is how Enzo Maresca is dealing with the succession and legacy of Pep Guardiola. Recent signs are unpromising.

In late 2026, the year of Harry Kane, another Englishman is setting controls for the Ballon d’Or. Jude Bellingham has never played a Premier League match but who in the world’s richest league could afford him? At half-time against PSV Eindhoven, Real Madrid were 1-0 down, and then José Mourinho threw on Bellingham. He scored only one of the five his team ran in, though it was spectacular; a volley bearing a light comparison to Madrid legend Zinedine Zidane’s goal in 2002’s final in Glasgow. “I think Zidane is much better than me, he’s much more elegant and he’s my idol,” said a humble Bellingham, while also dismissing talk of inheriting Kane’s crown.

Only their second season in the competition, their previous campaign coming in 2005-06, when Marcos Assunção, Ricardo Oliveira and Joaquín were the star names, Betis are sixth in the table with four wins from five. The knockouts beckon.

The 2026 vintage is full of experience, with Manuel Pellegrini, 73, coaching a team captained by Isco, 34, and still as inventive as ever. The star man in defeating Slovan Bratislava was the Colombian striker Cucho Hernández, previously of Columbus Crew. Two towering headers made sure Slovan remained bottom on zero points.

“I was convinced it was going to be a magical night for me personally,” said Hernández, who was returning after over a month’s absence. Troy Parrott faces a fight to get back in, having been the match-winner in Betis’s opening defeat of Lille. Wednesday was another night where Antony, a Manchester United escapee flourishing elsewhere, was a major threat.

“We don’t need to sign players in the transfer window, it’s not our style to sign a player for just six months. Above all, we’re not afraid of anything. We’re confident in our abilities and our resilience … Are we going to start crying and complaining? No, that’s not how a team operates.” – Paris Saint-Germain’s chances of a third title in succession were lowered when Désiré Doué joined Khvicha Kvaratskhelia in the ruptured ACL club. Their coach, Luis Enrique, remains unbowed but Wednesday’s 2-2 draw with Roma suggested certain vulnerabilities. A new-look front three of Maghnes Akliouche, Ferran Torres and Senny Mayulu started against the Serie A club.

Liverpool, following a 3-0 win at Club Brugge that belied the scoreline, are the highest-ranked English team in the standings in fifth and host Porto next time out. Arsenal, in seventh after their shaky draw with Dortmund on Tuesday, host Real Madrid in two huge Premier League-La Liga summits; Manchester City travel to Barcelona. Two top-eight surprise packages, Betis and Como, also meet.

items.titleZh: 欧冠综述：里尔击溃拜仁，德布劳内黯然重返曼城
items.summaryZh: 里尔击败拜仁取得欧冠小组赛首胜，贝蒂斯和贝林厄姆表现抢眼。
bodyZh: 拜仁慕尼黑遭遇了挫折，在主教练孔帕尼因健康问题回归工作之际，伤病却严重困扰着球队。在这场里尔取胜并送给拜仁本赛季首场失利的比赛中，亚历山大·帕夫洛维奇打入了一记匪夷所思的乌龙球，他在绝望回追时竟鬼使神差地将球碰入自家球门。拜仁目前在欧冠积分榜上排在第15位，随着哈里·凯恩将缺阵至2027年且只能让18岁的伦纳特·卡尔挑起锋线大梁，球队资源捉襟见肘。穆西亚拉由于神经系统疾病，也只能踢15分钟，此前俱乐部高层乌利·赫内斯和卡尔-海因茨·鲁梅尼格还曾就他的合同问题表达过不满。
相比之下，由大卫·安切洛蒂执教的里尔则赢得了赞誉，他们取得了小组赛的首场胜利。球队队长是36岁的本杰明·安德烈，他踢出了自己漫长职业生涯中最出色的比赛之一。在曾在其父亲卡洛手下效力于拜仁的安切洛蒂看来，他被“低估了”。“今晚有些不同寻常，我们踢得像个野兽。”

足球世界顶级的内容输送机器继续提供着高水平的娱乐。尽管评论家们对小组赛臃肿的赛制百般挑剔，但曼联却奉献了令人心跳加速、跌宕起伏的戏剧性场面。继对阵马德里竞技和科莫的悲情之后，曼联在葡萄牙体育主场上演了一出错误喜剧：森内·拉门斯扑出了路易斯·苏亚雷斯的点球，但随后的补射未能化解，接着又脱手送礼让同一名球员扳平比分，最终2-2的比分根本无法体现比赛的混乱程度。曼联的第二个进球、即布鲁诺·费尔南德斯的第二球同样充满滑稽色彩，阿尔瓦拉德球场草皮上的一个凹坑让费尔南德斯在保持平衡时不慎将球绊了一下，皮球随之弹过葡萄牙体育门将卡伊克·佩雷拉破门。此外，不得不提主裁希蒙·马齐尼亚克，他的执法表现奇怪且过分琐碎，吹掉了两个看似合法的曼联进球。
曼联是否有所有改善？这很难衡量。“带着今天的表现去备战下一场比赛，这就是最好的良药，”毛里西奥·波切蒂诺说道，他可能还带着时差，却已经深深陷入了曼联的泥潭。他的球队在欧冠和英超联赛中均排在第19位。
凯文·德布劳内重返阿提哈德球场勾起了球员和老东家的无限思念。曼城的状态依然挣扎，如今35岁的德布劳内也没有在纳不勒斯踢出理想的表现，而曼城内部在面临财务违规指控的不确定氛围中，依然试图维持常规业务的运转，翻新后球场空置的两层看台投下了意味深长的阴影。由于与一家以足球休闲服饰闻名的时尚公司合作，他们穿上了陌生的橙色球衣，这更增添了几分超现实主义色彩。
在雷扬·舍尔基的神奇发挥拯救球队逼平对手之后，埃尔林·哈兰德在赛后表示：“当你赢不了球时，你就会质疑一切。”这些疑问当中，就包括恩佐·马雷斯卡将如何处理佩普·瓜迪奥拉的继任与遗产。最近的迹象并不乐观。

在哈里·凯恩之年的2026年底，另一位英格兰人正向金球奖发起冲击。裘德·贝林厄姆从未踢过英超比赛，但世界最富有的联赛里有谁能买得起他？对阵埃因霍温的中场休息时，皇家马德里以0-1落后，随后何塞·穆里尼奥派上了贝林厄姆。他打入了球队连进五球中的一球，尽管只有一个，但极其精彩；这脚凌空抽射让人隐约联想到皇马传奇齐达内在2002年格拉斯哥决赛中的进球。“我认为齐达内比我优秀得多，他优雅得多，他是我的偶像，”谦逊的贝林厄姆说道，同时他也否认了继承凯恩王位的说法。
贝蒂斯目前在积分榜上以五战四胜排名第六，这仅仅是他们第二次参加该项赛事，上一次还要追溯到2005-06赛季，当时马科斯·阿松桑、里卡多·奥利维拉和华金还是球队的明星球员。淘汰赛近在咫尺。
订阅足球快讯
乔纳森·威尔逊和卫报记者为您带来关于足坛头条的专家分析和报道。
在新闻简报推广之后
2026届的这支球队经验丰富，73岁的佩莱格里尼执教着由34岁且依旧充满创意的伊斯科担任队长的一套阵容。在击败布拉提斯拉瓦斯洛万的比赛中，明星球员是此前效力于哥伦布机员的哥伦比亚前锋库乔·埃尔南德斯。两记头球破门确保了斯洛万继续积零分垫底。
“我坚信这对我个人来说将是一个神奇的夜晚，”缺阵一个多月后复出的埃尔南德斯说道。特洛伊·帕罗特在贝蒂斯击败里尔的揭幕战中曾是制胜功臣，如今他面临着夺回主力位置的竞争。周三的另一个看头是安东尼，这位离开曼联后在别处风生水起的球员构成了巨大的威胁。

“我们不需要在转会窗口签下球员，只签半年的球员不是我们的风格。最重要的是，我们无所畏惧。我们对自己的能力和韧性充满信心……难道我们要开始哭泣和抱怨吗？不，这不是一支球队的运作方式。”——随着德西雷·杜埃步克瓦拉茨赫利亚的后尘遭遇前十字韧带断裂，巴黎圣日耳曼实现三连冠的希望受到了削弱。他们的主帅路易斯·恩里克依然没有屈服，但周三与罗马2-2的平局表明这支球队确实存在某些隐患。对阵这家意甲俱乐部时，他们派出了由马格内斯·阿克利乌什、费兰·托雷斯和森尼·马尤卢组成的新三叉戟。
利物浦在客场3-0战胜布鲁日竞技（比分未能完全反映场上局势）后，成为积分榜上排名最高的英格兰球队，位列第五，下一轮他们将主场迎战波尔图。阿森纳在周二与多特蒙德惊险战平后排名第七，他们将在两场备受瞩目的英超与西甲巅峰对决中主场迎战皇家马德里；曼城则将客场挑战巴塞罗那。两支闯入前八的黑马贝蒂斯和科莫也将在下一轮直接对话。

items.summaryEn: Rivals engage law firm Wiggin as they seek damagesClaim could be worth hundreds of millions of poundsManchester United, Liverpool and Tottenham are using the same law firm to prepare a legal claim against Manchester City for breaking the Premier League’s financial rules that could be worth hundreds of millions of pounds.The clubs have engaged the services of the London-based media, entertainment and technology specialists Wiggin. Arsenal are using their retained lawyers, HFS Kramer, to prepare their own claim. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Manchester United, Liverpool and Tottenham are using the same law firm to prepare a legal claim against Manchester City for breaking the Premier League’s financial rules that could be worth hundreds of millions of pounds.
The clubs have engaged the services of the London-based media, entertainment and technology specialists Wiggin. Arsenal are using their retained lawyers, HFS Kramer, to prepare their own claim.

A source with knowledge of the case disclosed there had been a degree of cooperation between the clubs using Wiggin, because they have also engaged the same analysts to assess the size of the potential losses allegedly caused by City’s financial cheating, but that they would bring separate claims for damages.
“The cases are similar but different,” the source said. “The ultimate causation may be the same, but the damages will be different so they will be separate claims.”

Another source disclosed that Tottenham initially engaged Wiggin while Daniel Levy was the chair and were the first club to make legal moves against City after they were charged with financial fair play breaches in February 2023, with United and Liverpool following their lead.

Those three clubs and Arsenal lodged legal notices in November 2024 reserving their right to seek compensation against City to avoid their potential claims being ruled time-barred, one of the mechanisms through which City succeeded in 2020 in having a two-year ban from the Champions League imposed by Uefa for similar alleged offences lifted by the court of arbitration for sport.

Standard breach of contract claims have a six-year statute limitation from the moment they are made public, and with the allegations of City’s rule-breaking first published in the German news magazine Der Spiegel in November 2018, four of the other members of the big six acted to reserve their rights.

Chelsea did not instruct lawyers to begin a claim against City at that point, and are not believed to have done so since, despite the fact that extensions to the time limit can be granted in cases of fraud and concealment.

The four clubs who are preparing legal action have stepped up their activities since the Premier League announced in September that City had been found guilty of the vast majority of more than 100 charges against them, with an independent commission ruling that the club had artificially inflated its income by more than £900m through the use of “sham contracts” between 2009 and 2018.

Tottenham are likely to make the biggest claim against City because they missed out on Champions League qualification to them on four occasions during that period, with dropping into the Europa League costing them more than £120m.

United and Liverpool finished second in the Premier League to City during years when City have been found to have inflated their income, in 2012 and 2014 respectively, costing them prize money and commercial revenue and bonuses.

Arsenal missed out on Champions League qualification by finishing fifth in the Premier League in 2017, the start of a six-season run outside Europe’s elite competition that combined will have cost them hundreds of millions of pounds, as City ended up third.

Arsenal also sold five key players to City during the period of their breaches – Kolo Touré, Gaël Clichy, Emmanuel Adebayor, Bacary Sagna and Samir Nasri – and may claim additional losses on the grounds that their purchases were artificially funded.
Everton, Newcastle and Chelsea also missed out on Champions League places during the relevant period, and numerous clubs including Hull were relegated in part owing to their results against City.
Stoke lost the 2011 FA Cup final to City, costing them a Europa League place, and their then manager, Tony Pulis, said in October that the club should be awarded the trophy.

City have denied wrongdoing since being charged almost four years ago and have launched an appeal against the independent commission’s verdict, which will be heard by a new three-person panel next month. After launching their appeal in October, City issued a statement saying the commission’s judgment contained “multiple clear material errors of law, principle and fact and is unsafe” and that “the club is innocent of the accusations made by the Premier League and a comprehensive body of irrefutable evidence exists in support of all its positions, relating to this case”.

items.titleZh: 曼联、利物浦和热刺聘请同一家律所对曼城提起法律诉讼
items.summaryZh: 曼联、利物浦和热刺聘请同一律所准备起诉曼城，阿森纳则使用自己的律师。
bodyZh: 曼联、利物浦和热刺正在使用同一家律师事务所，准备就曼城违反英超财务规则一事对其实施法律索赔，金额可能高达数亿英镑。
这些俱乐部已聘请总部位于伦敦的媒体、娱乐和技术专业律所Wiggin。阿森纳则使用其聘用的律师事务所HFS Kramer来准备他们自己的索赔。
一位知情人士透露，使用Wiggin的俱乐部之间存在一定程度的合作，因为他们还聘请了相同的分析师来评估曼城财务违规据称造成的潜在损失规模，但他们将分别提出损害赔偿诉讼。
知情人士表示：“这些案件相似但又不同。最终的因果关系可能是一样的，但损害赔偿会有所不同，因此它们将是独立的索赔。”
另一位知情人士透露，热刺最初是在丹尼尔·列维（Daniel Levy）担任主席时聘用Wiggin的，并且在曼城于2023年2月被指控违反财务公平竞赛规则后，热刺是第一家对曼城采取法律行动的俱乐部，曼联和利物浦随后效仿。
这三家俱乐部和阿森纳于2024年11月提交了法律通知，保留了他们寻求对曼城进行赔偿的权利，以避免他们的潜在索赔被裁定为过诉讼时效。这是曼城在2020年成功利用的机制之一，当时欧足联因类似的涉嫌违规行为对曼城实施的两年欧冠禁赛令被国际体育仲裁法庭撤销。
标准的违反合同索赔自公开之日起有六年的诉讼时效限制。随着曼城违规指控于2018年11月首次在德国新闻杂志《明镜周刊》上发表，六大俱乐部中的其他四家采取行动保留了他们的权利。
切尔西当时并未指示律师对曼城提起诉讼，据信此后也没有这样做，尽管在欺诈和隐瞒的情况下可以延长时效期限。
自从英超联赛在9月份宣布曼城被裁定对其面临的100多项指控中的绝大多数负有罪责以来，正在准备法律行动的四家俱乐部已经加大了行动力度。一个独立委员会裁定，在2009年至2018年期间，该俱乐部通过使用“虚假合同”虚增了超过9亿英镑的收入。
热刺可能会对曼城提出最大的索赔，因为在那段时期他们曾四次错失欧冠资格，落入欧联杯导致他们损失了超过1.2亿英镑。
在曼城被发现虚增收入的年份里（分别为2012年和2014年），曼联和利物浦在英超联赛中获得亚军，这导致他们损失了奖金、商业收入和奖金。

阿森纳在2017年英超联赛中获得第五名，从而错失了欧冠资格。这是他们长达六个赛季无缘欧洲顶级赛事周期的开始，总共将让他们损失数亿英镑，当时曼城最终排名第三。
阿森纳还在曼城违规期间将五名关键球员出售给曼城——科洛·图雷（Kolo Touré）、加埃尔·克利希（Gaël Clichy）、埃马纽埃尔·阿德巴约（Emmanuel Adebayor）、巴卡里·萨尼亚（Bacary Sagna）和萨米尔·纳斯里（Samir Nasri），并可能以其购买资金被人为资助为由索赔额外损失。
埃弗顿、纽卡斯尔和切尔西在相关时期也错失了欧冠席位，包括赫尔城在内的众多俱乐部降级部分原因是对阵曼城的战绩。
斯托克城在2011年足总杯决赛中输给曼城，错失了欧联杯席位，他们当时的经理托尼·普利斯（Tony Pulis）在10月份表示，该俱乐部应该被授予该奖杯。
曼城在近四年前被指控以来一直否认有任何不当行为，并对独立委员会的裁决提起上诉，该裁决将于下个月由一个新的三人小组审理。在10月份提起上诉后，曼城发表声明称，委员会的裁决包含“多项明显的法律、原则和事实方面的重大错误，且不可靠”，“俱乐部对英超联赛的指控是清白的，并且存在一套全面且无可辩驳的证据来支持其与本案有关的所有立场”。

bodyEn: The footballer Peter Storey, who has died aged 81, was a tough-tackling midfielder for Arsenal when they won the double of the First Division championship and the FA Cup in 1971.

Arsenal were only the fourth team to achieve the double at that point (it has since been won another nine times), and Storey, who appeared in 49 of the 51 league and FA Cup games that season, played as big a role as anyone in securing the honours with his defensive solidity, ball-winning skills, “good engine”, sound distribution and reliable occasional penalty taking.

Those attributes garnered him 501 appearances for Arsenal overall – putting him eighth on their all-time list – and made him popular not just at Highbury in a famous team that also featured Bob Wilson, Pat Rice, Frank McLintock and Charlie George, but with the England manager Alf Ramsey, who handed him 19 international caps between 1971 and 1973 in midfield and defence. By 1977, however, Storey’s footballing career was finished at the relatively young age of 32, and he soon experienced a precipitous fall from grace.

In 1975, while still a player, he had taken on the lease of the Jolly Farmers pub in Islington, north London, not far from Highbury. After leaving football he ran the establishment full-time, a move that exacerbated an existing propensity to heavy drinking. The Jolly Farmers was also a hangout for criminal elements, including members of one of the UK’s biggest crime enterprises, the Adams family, and Storey began to fall in with a number of unsavoury contacts, ushering in a drink-fuelled decline that involved a conviction for running a brothel and a three-year prison sentence for taking part in a money-counterfeiting conspiracy.

Born in Farnham, Surrey, Peter was the son of Nellie (nee Cawson), a shop assistant, and Edwin Storey, a carpenter. Growing up on the Longacre council estate in the nearby village of Ash, he went to Yeoman’s Bridge secondary school (now Ash Manor school) and there, through appearances in county schools football, caught the attention of Arsenal, the team he supported.

He went to Highbury as an apprentice in 1961, and made his first-team debut in 1965 under the manager Billy Wright, at left-back in a First Division match against Leicester City. Immediately establishing himself in the side, by 1967 he was switched by a new manager, Bertie Mee, to right-back to accommodate Bob McNab, appearing in that position in two losing League Cup finals, against Don Revie’s Leeds in 1968 and Swindon in 1969.

Moving not long afterwards into midfield, he claimed his first winner’s medal in the Inter-Cities Fairs Cup (the precursor to the Uefa Cup) in 1970 as Arsenal beat Anderlecht 4-3 over a two-legged final to claim their first trophy in 17 years.

By then a well-oiled machine, the team went on to win the 1971 league title by one point ahead of Leeds, although Storey missed the crucial last two games of the campaign with an ankle injury. Recovered in time for the FA Cup final, he put in an effective performance for 64 minutes before being substituted, then watched from the bench as George scored an extra-time winner to deliver the double with a 2-1 victory over Bill Shankly’s Liverpool. Earlier in the competition Storey had rescued Arsenal from a semi-final exit against Stoke City by putting two goals past the mighty Gordon Banks – one a crisply struck half-volley and the other an ice-cool penalty in stoppage time. Stoke had been 2-0 up, and in the resulting replay were defeated comfortably.

After the double, Arsenal were unable to maintain any meaningful momentum, and Storey, too, began to find things more difficult. Hampered by his drinking habits, by 1975 he was struggling to hold down a first-team place, leading to fallouts with Mee and then Mee’s successor, Terry Neill.

Neill let Storey go on a free transfer in early 1977 to Second Division Fulham, where he joined a cast of enthusiastic imbibers in Bobby Moore, George Best and Rodney Marsh, each also at the end of their careers. After less than a year at Craven Cottage, Storey signed off with a last match in September 1977, before turning his attention more fully to the Jolly Farmers.
Later admitting that he was “attracted to the brash, flash lifestyle enjoyed by smartly dressed thieves who frequented my pub”, he readily became involved in criminal activity.

Within two years of his playing retirement, Storey had been found guilty of keeping a brothel, for which he received a suspended sentence. In late 1980 he was convicted of conspiracy to produce counterfeit gold coins, and was sent to Wandsworth prison for three years. Released before serving the full sentence, he then set up a minicab business, but in 1982 narrowly avoided being sent back to jail after trying to steal two cars he had initially bought for his firm on hire purchase. He was jailed again in 1990, for 28 days, for the illegal importation of pornographic videos.

After his second period behind bars Storey worked as a minicab driver for a firm run by the Adams family, then as a chauffeur in Turkey. Less turbulent times arrived with his fourth marriage, in 2000, to a Frenchwoman, Daniele Scorcelletti, with whom he lived more quietly for many years near Toulouse, partly on the proceeds of selling his football medals for £20,000.
His warts-and-all autobiography, True Storey: My Life and Crimes As a Football Hatchet Man, was published in 2010.

Each of Storey’s first three marriages ended in divorce, the first being to Susan Thompson in 1969. He had a daughter, Natalie, from his second marriage, to Catherine Macdonald, and three sons, Peter, Anthony and Jamie, from his third marriage, to Gillian Ashby.
Peter Edwin Storey, footballer, born 7 September 1945; died 17 November 2026
